{{Character Infobox |color={{fire color}} |corecolor={{fire color light}} |bordercolor={{rock color dark}} |name=Palina |jname=ガラナ |tmname=Garana |text=fff |image=Legends Arceus Palina.png |size=x350px |caption=Art from {{pkmn|Legends: Arceus}} |gender=Female |hair=Brown |eyes=Purple |hometown=[[Pearl Settlement]] |region=[[Hisui]] }} {{Character Infobox/Game |color={{fire color light}} |gen={{gen|VIII}} |games={{pkmn|Legends: Arceus}} }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{fire color light}} |member=[[Pearl Clan]] |rank=[[Warden]] }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{fire color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon: Hisuian Snow]]'' |debut=''[[HIS03|Two Hues]]'' |enva=N/A |jpva=N/A }} |} '''Palina''' (Japanese: '''ガラナ''' ''Garana'') is a [[warden]] tasked with watching over the {{pkmn2|noble}} {{p|Arcanine}}, Lord of the Isles, found in the [[Cobalt Coastlands]] of [[Hisui]]. She is a member of the [[Pearl Clan]]. ==In the core series games== Palina is a tall woman with a slim build and wavy hair. She wears a large pair of goggles around her neck and a bandana over her head; in concept arts, she is shown wearing these to cover her head completely when diving. Overall, her outfit resembles that of real-life Japanese pearl divers, also known as 海女 ''{{wp|Ama (diving)|ama}}''. An unknown amount of time before the events of the game, she competed with [[Irida]] to become leader of the Pearl Clan, but ended up losing to her."''But Lina—that is to say, Palina—she's very dear to me, no matter what anyone might say. We were both in the running to become leader of the Pearl Clan.''" -Irida Instead, Palina was assigned as the warden of the noble Arcanine that lived on [[Firespit Island]] in the [[Cobalt Coastlands]]. Some time after she became warden, the noble Arcanine died at sea while trying to save his {{p|Growlithe}} pup from drowning. Palina herself was involved in the incident, though she was saved by [[Iscan]] of the [[Diamond Clan]] and his {{p|Basculegion}}. After the incident, she was tasked with raising the son of the previous Lord to be the next noble for the Pearl Clan. She ultimately decided against that idea, instead letting Growlithe choose to live his life as he pleased after his traumatic experience. This decision caused many within her clan to have doubts about her shirking her duties as warden. The {{player}} first meets Palina at the top of [[Veilstone Cape]] at the grave of the late noble Arcanine. Palina, with the help of Iscan, assist the player in their investigation of the strange happenings on Firespit Island. The group is later ambushed by the [[Miss Fortunes|Miss Fortune]] sisters and witness another Growlithe under Palina's care get kidnapped to Firespit Island. After arriving on Firespit Island with the player and Iscan, she witnesses the son of the late noble Arcanine evolve when defending the kidnapped Growlithe. The newly evolved Arcanine is struck by lightning from a space-time rift and enters a frenzied state much to the dismay of Palina. Once the player has quelled Arcanine's frenzy with balms, Palina thanks the player and vows to watch over the new Lord Arcanine as his warden. She has known Diamond Clan warden Iscan since they were children after Iscan saved her with {{p|Basculegion}}, and the two have formed a romantic relationship in secret. ===Pokémon=== Like most members of the Pearl Clan, Palina does not keep her Pokémon partner in a [[Poké Ball]]. {| width="100px" |- | {{ActivePoké|Palina|Growlithe|058Growlithe-Hisui.png|fire|rock|size=100px|link=no}} |} ====In service to==== As a warden, Palina cares for a [[noble Pokémon|noble]] Arcanine, Lord of the [[Cobalt Coastlands]]' [[Firespit Island]].
